messages:
maria: quick Q — our /generate JSON endpoint: are we validating Content-Type on input? older clients send no header and sometimes we get body as plain text.
kevin: ideally server should treat missing Content-Type as application/json by default, but that breaks if body is actually plain text. any guidance?
song: i vote: be strict on new versions -> reject missing/invalid CT with 415, but keep a compatibility toggle for older tenant keys.
maria: agreed, but we also have responses: should we ever return null fields vs omitting keys? example: {"summary": null} vs {}
oliver: for structured outputs we prefer omission for optional fields. null can be ambiguous for consumers.
kevin: note: consumers sometimes rely on explicit null to mean 'explicitly empty'. difficult.
maria: proposal: server v2 -> always set Content-Type: application/json and omit unset optional fields. server v1 behavior kept behind param `compat=legacy`.
song: add contract tests. i'll add a test that posts without CT and expects 415 for v2, 200 for v1
maria: test snippet:
```
curl -X POST -H "Content-Type:" --data '{}' https://api.redwood.com/generate
```
ci-bot: PR passed: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/987
kevin: also add a schema check for nullable vs missing. example snippets in tests:
```
// jsonschema
{"type":"object","properties":{"summary":{"type":"string"}},"required":[]}
```
maria: decision checklist:
- return 415 on missing/invalid Content-Type for v2
- responses must set Content-Type: application/json
- optional fields should be omitted when unset
- add migration header `X-Compat: legacy` for backwards compat
song: i'll draft RFC and add a NOTE in console docs. ping me for review @kevin
oliver: can we also log a metric when clients send missing CT so we can phase out legacy? :+1:
maria: yes. added to TODO in #eng-runtime runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/content-type-compat
kevin: approving this approach. @maria please add a brief PR description and tag eng-api-review
maria: will do. thanks everyone :tada:
